mission: From the visible garden spawn, inspect all three subject rows and their GRAY frozen 3D, BLUE plain capture, RED 7035 control, and GOLD ghost-plate columns. At the exact GOLD source view, judge whether each subject reads as one coherent deliberately low-resolution image. Freeze sector follow in the V lab, then circle-strafe at normal speed through roughly plus or minus 8 to 12 degrees, approach and retreat, jump or seek modest elevation, and inspect close/medium distance plus partial terrain occlusion in the bright fogged world. Report whether GOLD produces restrained connected relief and feels intentionally sprite-like; record smear, holes, folding, z-fighting, floating, pose mismatch, or topology-dependent breakup. notes: Judge visible behavior through genuine mouse and keyboard input. Do not inspect DOM, websocket state, source, or hidden readouts. Finish with playtest_finish and an exit interview that separates harness/control friction, implementation defects, and aesthetic underwhelm; suggest the next lever among source-shell integrity, sectors, held animation, plate compilation, grounding, and regional depth.
